question: After the contributor provides inspectable focused test output and the exact-head caller scan is confirmed, should this protected maintainer-labelled cleanup be merged?
rationale: The `maintainer` label requires explicit human handling, while the remaining merge gate is evidence rather than a mechanical code repair.

options.title: Verify and merge
options.body: Confirm there are no remaining callers at the current head, review redacted focused terminal proof, and merge if the normal required checks pass.

options.title: Keep the exports
options.body: Retain the wrappers if maintainers intend these internal exports to remain supported test or module seams.

recommendation.title: Verify and merge
recommendation.body: Confirm there are no remaining callers at the current head, review redacted focused terminal proof, and merge if the normal required checks pass.
